+# hushrun.yaml: where this repository's events go.
+version: 1
+repository: github.com/acme/shop
+backend: <your org's URL, once you sign in>

commands.after: hushrun run test-ci -- make test-ci -j1 V=1

commands.ciText: a later step reads its reports (codecov/codecov-action), and a skip writes none

commands.after: hushrun run ui-test -- make -C web ui-test

commands.why: its recipe pushes an image (docker push)

notes: your org: connects github.com/acme/shop, so that its CI records results with its own ID token
your org: adds github.com/acme/shop to your org's dashboard, unless it is there already
hushrun.yaml: a new file: repository github.com/acme/shop, its URL on hushrun, and the key that verifies hushrun's log
CI runs test every time: a later step reads its reports (codecov/codecov-action). Laptops and agents skip it on a pass.

To let CI skip test too, set reports.ci: skip for it in hushrun.yaml and give the Codecov step if: steps.test.outputs.hushrun-skipped != 'true', with id: test on the step that runs test. That is safe when Codecov carries the step's flag forward (carryforward: true) and after_n_builds doesn't count its upload.
